t: This is the site of the Lyric Opera House in Hammersmith. The theatre itself has been demolished, but its auditorium interior was moved into a new building, which is now the Lyric Hammersmith. The original was designed by Frank Matcham, the English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls and designed more than ninety of them in a forty-year career. So when you step inside the Lyric today, you're sitting in a room that is, in effect, his.
